name: Epilepsy-iEEG-Multicenter-Dataset (fragility cohort)

access.steps: OpenNeuro download. Cleveland Clinic patients are withheld and need a separate DUA.

modalities: Ictal iEEG snapshots only: 106 runs, median 241 s (8.2 h total); ~1000 Hz typical (250–2000 Hz); median 115 channels
labels: Seizure onset/offset events in events.tsv (free-text marks, e.g. 'sz onset'); SOZ and resection labels are not in channels.tsv; README points to sourcedata/clinical_data_summary.xlsx
outcomes: Success 20 / failure 10 / not resected 5; Engel and ILAE scores; 1–7 years follow-up
caveats: No MRI, no electrode coordinates, no coordsystem files: cannot be placed on a virtual brain
Seizure spread/propagation is not annotated: events carry only onset/offset marks
11,015 ECoG vs 125 SEEG channel rows: SEEG-poor, unlike VEC/VEP
checks: Cloned git tree: participants.tsv (35 rows), 106 ieeg.json sidecars, 106 channels/events files, sourcedata listing. R1 found the same gaps.
pipeline: EEG-only benchmark for the onset/fragility agent and for outcome prediction. Pair it with its companion ds003876, which carries per-channel SOZ labels. Not usable for V4 (virtual surgery), which needs coordinates.
key_claim: Open 4-centre ictal iEEG with outcomes, but no coordinates or MRI, and SOZ labels live in an Excel sheet.

evidence.quote: We publish 4 centers' dataset here due to data sharing issues.
We develop and retrospectively validate a new electroencephalogram (EEG) marker-neural fragility-in a retrospective analysis of 91 patients
